statements.status_notes: CVE-2024-55565 is fixed in nanoid 5.0.9. A global pnpm override to >=5.0.9 breaks @trigger.dev/core's CommonJS build (TS1479: ESM-only nanoid imported via require). @trigger.dev/core keeps its pinned nanoid 3.3.8 resolution. This nanoid 5.0.6 instance comes from a separate transitive consumer; assessing whether that code path is reachable at runtime.
